title: What is AI?

lines.narration: How does your phone know what you'll type next?
lines.spoken: How does your phone know what you'll type next?

lines.narration: Try writing rules to spot a cat in every photo. There are endless possibilities.
lines.spoken: Try writing rules to spot a cat in every photo. There are endless possibilities.

lines.narration: Meet AI, artificial intelligence. Machines that mimic human thinking.
lines.spoken: Meet A I, artificial intelligence. Machines that mimic human thinking.

lines.narration: Instead of rules, it learns from data. First, it studies millions of examples. Then it finds the patterns, builds a model from them, and uses that model to predict new things, like your next word.
lines.spoken: Instead of rules, it learns from data. First, it studies millions of examples. Then it finds the patterns, builds a model from them, and uses that model to predict new things, like your next word.

lines.narration: AI learns like a student: practice, not a rulebook. Follow for more!
lines.spoken: A I learns like a student: practice, not a rulebook. Follow for more!

instagram_caption: How does your phone guess your next word? It isn't following a giant rulebook. AI learns patterns from millions of examples, then uses them to predict new things. What's the most useful AI you use every day?
youtube_title: What is AI? Explained in 30 seconds #Shorts
youtube_description: AI lets computers mimic human thinking skills. Instead of following hand-written rules, it learns patterns from huge amounts of example data, then uses them to make predictions, like your phone suggesting your next word.
